capability: Keep every mismatch visible, never smoothed
title: Leave the flag where it is.

hook.picture: Close on the whale reading a pinned card ('works') above a stretch of line with a visible gap. The whale smooths over the gap with one flat fin stroke. It looks fine.
hook.words: The readme says it is done.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The readme says it works. The code says no.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer on day one of a project

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: pinned cards above a long line, each with a smoothed-over gap below. Three pods trip on them, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each mismatch got smoothed over and lost.

stakes.body: Every smoothed-over mismatch becomes a trap for the next person. Hours are lost rediscovering what someone already saw.

solution_hint: Mark every mismatch. Do not smooth it.

metaphor.body: Pins above the line are written promises. Where a piece of the line disagrees with its pin, the joint glows copper and a flag is planted and left standing until someone really fixes it. The done lamp stays dark while any flag stands.

steps.picture: Each pinned promise drops a thread to the line. Where the line agrees the joint ticks teal, and where it does not, it glows copper.
steps.words: Compare each promise to what is there.
steps.sound: Teal ticks, then one copper bell left ringing

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): at each copper joint a small flag is planted, and it stays. The whale does not smooth it.
steps.words: Disagreement gets a flag, not a patch.
steps.sound: A flag snap, the bell still ringing

steps.picture: A 'done' lamp at the end of the line stays dark while any flag stands.
steps.words: Done stays off while a flag stands.

steps.picture: Pull back to the joints. The copper ones pulse once.

real_case.claim: The jev-elder collector pack keeps eight residuals (δ1–δ8) with "do not fold". δ1: the README lists docs the tree does not contain. "Φ is false until δ2 and δ3 close."

honest_limit.picture: Still. A stretch of line with no pin above it sags badly: no thread, no glow, no flag. A pod trips there anyway.
honest_limit.words: No promise written, so no flag.

not_this.body: It only checks what you pinned down.

ending_pattern.body: A flag, not a paddle: at the same gap the whale plants a flag instead of smoothing it over, and the next pod gets through.
ending_pattern.callback: The gap the whale smoothed over in bar 1 now carries a standing flag that the pod sees.

end_belief.body: Keep the mismatch visible until it is fixed.
